newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns A- rating to United Energy notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns A- rating to United Energy notes.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it had assigned an A-minus long term and A2 short term rating to United Energy Ltd's A$500 million medium term note and commercial paper programme.
The ratings agency said the commercial paper issue is further evidence of the growing demand for A2 rated commercial paper in Australia.
It said the rating outlook is stable.
S&P said the company has a natural monopoly in the network component of its business, which is located in Melbourne and the nearby Mornington Peninsula region in the state of Victoria.
